image_description: A male mallard duck (drake) resting on a patch of green grass against a textured grey stone wall. The duck displays characteristic breeding plumage with an iridescent green head, white neck ring, brown chest, and greyish-brown body. Its bill is yellow-green with a dark tip, and it appears to be tucking its head slightly into its back feathers.

The visible eye is small, round, and distinctly dark/black, contrasting with the green head feathers.
